services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: We are the only lobster boat tour in Bar Harbor hosted on a traditional Downeast-style lobster boat. Lulu’s two-hour lobster boat ride offers the most exclusive, personal and unique cruise in Bar Harbor. Experience lobster fishing, seal watching, sightseeing and more! We sail from the Harborside Hotel & Marina right in downtown Bar Harbor, one of the most beautiful hotels on the coast of Maine! Enjoy comfortable, shaded seating with a front-row seat to the lobster fishing action. Our experienced captains will catch lobsters right before your eyes, while narrators educate you about all the parts of a lobster trap and how the lobsters find their way into the trap. blurb: Guests take a two-hour tour aboard a traditional lobster boat to learn about Maine lobsters and how they are caught. The tour includes sightseeing of coastal Maine, wildlife observation including seals and bald eagles, and a lobster trap demonstration. Tours depart from the Bar Harbor waterfront at the Harborside Hotel & Marina.
